accept_policy_checkbox: I have read the policy above
active_next_round_modal_choose_descripti: You can choose to either (check the checkbox or not):
active_next_round_modal_choose_option_ch: Adjust the start times of the next matches to start immediately(now). This will be done by modifying the margin times of the matches in the previous round.
active_next_round_modal_choose_option_un: Use default timing (the next matches will be planned tightly after the matches of the active round end, taking margin into account)
active_next_round_modal_description: This will assign times and courts to matches of next round, which is the round after the current activated (green) round.
active_next_round_modal_title: Assign times and courts to matches of next round
active_next_stage_modal_description: This will start the next stage. Teams will be automatically assigned to the matches.
active_previous_stage_modal_description: Are you sure you want to go back to the previous stage? Match results will be discarded.
active_previous_stage_modal_title: Go back to the previous stage
adjust_start_times_checkbox_label: Adjust start time of matches in this round to the current time
all_matches_scheduled_description: Matches have been scheduled on all courts in this round. Add a new round or add a new court for more matches.
archived_header_label: This tournament is archived. It is now read-only.
back_home_nav: Take me back to home page
capacity_description: Plan a cup before anyone registers: enter the classes, courts and playing hours. The matches are planned with the real scheduler, including rest, game formats and playoffs that wait for the groups. The ages fill in suggested NFF game formats and match lengths.
capacity_estimate_note: An estimate: the real match plan depends on the registered teams, and can be fine-tuned afterwards.
capacity_warning_playoffs_in_childrens_f: Playoffs in children's football (NFF: no playoffs for 12 and younger)
capacity_warning_too_few_matches: Some teams get fewer than 3 matches (NFF: at least 3 for 13 and younger)
capacity_warning_too_many_matches_per_da: Teams can get more than 5 matches, too many for one day at this age
categories_description: Age classes (e.g. G10 or J12) each get their own stages and teams, and share the courts of the tournament. Results of children's classes (12 and younger) are hidden by default, following the NFF rules.
category_age_input_description: Used to follow the NFF rules, e.g. hiding results for 12 and younger
category_game_format_description: Matches are only planned on courts of this format (or without a format)
club_select_placeholder: Pick a club for this tournament
create_account_alert_description: Account creation is disabled on this domain for now since bracket is still in beta phase
create_playoffs_description: Creates a new stage after {{stage}} ({{count}} groups) with a knockout bracket per playoff. Group winners are seeded first and teams from the same group meet as late as possible, e.g. 1A–2B and 1B–2A.
dashboard_public_description: Allow anyone to see the dashboard of rounds and matches
demo_description: To test Bracket, you can start a demo. A demo will last for 30 minutes, after which your demo account be deleted. Please make fair use of it.
draft_round_checkbox_label: This round is a draft round
duration_minutes_choose_title: Please choose a duration of the matches
margin_minutes_choose_title: Please choose a margin between matches
min_rest_description: Extra time a team rests between its matches, on top of the time between matches
miscellaneous_label: Allow players to be in multiple teams
multiple_players_input_label: Add multiple players. Put every player on a separate line
multiple_teams_input_label: Add multiple teams. Put every team on a separate line. You can also add players per team, separated by `,`.
no_categories_description: Add a class for each age group in your cup. A tournament without classes works as before.
no_courts_description: No courts have been created yet. First, create the tournament structure by adding stages and stage items. Then, create courts here and schedule matches on these courts.
no_courts_description_swiss: No courts have been created yet. First add courts before managing a Swiss stage item.
no_matches_description: First, add matches by creating stages and stage items. Then, schedule them using the button in the topright corner.
no_round_description: There are no rounds in this stage item yet
no_round_found_description: Please wait for the organiser to add them.
no_round_found_in_stage_description: There are no rounds in this stage yet
no_time_windows: No playing hours yet: the match plan starts at the start time of the tournament.
not_found_description: Unfortunately, this is only a 404 page. You may have mistyped the address, or the page has been moved to another URL.
not_found_title: You have found a secret place.
only_recommended_input_group_label: Only show teams that played less matches
penalties_need_winner_validation: A penalty shootout must have a winner
penalties_require_draw_validation: A penalty shootout is only possible when the score is equal
penalties_required_validation: Enter the number of penalties scored
plan_issue_court_overlap: {{match}} overlaps with {{other}} on the same court
plan_issue_team_overlap: {{match}} overlaps with {{other}} for the same team
plan_issue_wrong_game_format: {{match}} is on a court of another game format
plan_previous_stage_button: Go back to the previous stage
playoff_best_of_placing_description: E.g. the best third placed teams across all groups
playoff_best_of_placing_label: Also the best teams at placing
policy_not_accepted: Please indicate that you have read the policy
results_hidden_alert: The public dashboard only shows whether matches have been played, without scores or tables. This class can only have round robin groups, without playoffs.
results_public_description: NFF: results and tables may only be published from the 13-year class
round_robin_description: Each team plays every other team once.
save_result_description: A live score is shown on the dashboard, but only counts in tables and brackets once you save the result.
schedule_apply_description: Played matches and matches with a live score keep their place. Matches that don't fit stay unplanned.
schedule_default_window_alert: No playing hours are set, so a 12 hour day from the tournament start time is used. Set the playing hours above.
schedule_does_not_fit_description: Only {{scheduled}} of {{total}} matches fit. To fit all matches you need:
schedule_extra_time: {{duration}} more playing time at the end
schedule_fits_description: All {{count}} matches fit in the playing hours.
schedule_more_courts_dont_help: More courts don't help (e.g. teams need their rest),
schedule_more_time_doesnt_help: More time doesn't help either, check the game formats of classes and courts
single_elimination_description: Teams play against each other, where one loss results in elimination.
stage_buffer_description: Time between the last match of a stage and the first match of the next stage of a class
stage_spotlight_description: Change the layout of the tournament
standings_hidden_alert: Tables are not shown for classes with hidden results (children's football).
swiss_description: Teams play against equal teams, based on the results of previous matches.
team_count_elimination_description: Any number from 2 to 64. When it's not 2, 4, 8, 16 etc., some teams get a bye in the first round.
team_count_input_round_robin_label: Number of teams advancing from the previous stage
team_count_select_elimination_label: Number of teams advancing from the previous stage
team_member_select_placeholder: Pick team members for this team
third_place_match_description: The losers of the semifinals play for third place (needs at least 4 teams)
tiebreakers_description: Used in this order when teams have the same number of points. Write the order in the tournament rules.
time_windows_description: When can matches be played? Choose the days, the daily start and end, and optionally a lunch break.
title: Title
tournament_not_started_description: Please wait for the tournament to start.
tournament_setting_spotlight_description: Change the settings of the tournament
upload_placeholder_team: Drop a file here to upload as team logo.
upload_placeholder_tournament: Drop a file here to upload as tournament logo.
warning_children_results_public: Results are published, but the NFF does not allow that for age 12 and younger.
warning_too_few_matches: {{count}} team(s) can get fewer than 3 matches (as few as {{minimum}}). The NFF requires at least 3 matches per team for age 13 and younger: {{teams}}
warning_unplaced_teams: {{count}} team(s) are not placed in a group yet: {{teams}}
setup_description: Set up a new cup in one go: classes with groups and playoffs, courts and playing days. The groups get their teams later, in the draw.
setup_not_empty_alert: The setup wizard only works for a tournament without classes and stages. Use a new tournament, or change this one on the pages for classes and stages.
setup_review_description: This is what will be created. Nothing is saved before you click the button.
setup_plan_matches_label: Plan times and courts for the matches right away
club_name_input_description: Keeps teams of the same club apart in the group draw. Empty: the club is guessed from the team name ("Brann 2" is Brann).
draw_description: Draws the teams of a class into the empty places of its groups. With pots, every group gets one team from each pot; teams of the same club end up in different groups where possible.
draw_pot_count_description: 1: everyone in the same pot (removes the saved pots)
draw_too_many_teams_alert: There are more teams than free places. Add groups or larger groups first.
draw_no_teams_left: All teams of this class have been drawn.
draw_adjust_note: To move a team afterwards, change it in its group on the stages page.
score_links_description: A result link lets someone at a pitch enter results on their phone without an account. Make one per pitch and put the QR code on the pitch, or one for the secretariat.
score_link_shown_once_alert: Copy or print the link now: for security it can't be shown again. If it gets lost, revoke it and make a new one.
score_problem_penalties_equal: A penalty shootout only follows an equal score.
score_problem_penalties_winner: The penalty shootout must have a winner.
report_delay_description: E.g. that this pitch is running late. The organiser sees it right away.
score_link_invalid_description: Ask the organiser for a new link.
score_teams_unknown: The teams of this match are not known yet.
score_all_played: All matches have been played. Thank you!
walkover_goals_description: A team that doesn't show up loses by this many goals to 0
withdraw_team_description: All matches the team hasn't played yet are given to its opponents as a walkover. The schedule stays the same. This can't be undone automatically: reinstating the team keeps the walkovers.
team_withdrawn_message: {{team}} has been withdrawn; {{count}} matches were given as walkover.
team_reinstated_message: {{team}} takes part again. Change walkovers per match if needed.
score_walkover_description: Which team showed up? It wins {{goals}}–0.
walkover_winner_label: Walkover: the other team didn't show up
announcement_description: Shown at the top of all public pages and the big screen.
announcement_text_placeholder: E.g. Thunder: all matches are paused until 14:00
big_screen_link: Big screen (rotates between courts, matches and tables)
match_card_notes_label: Notes (goal scorers are not needed, cards and injuries are)
match_cards_description: Two cards per row; a card is never split over two pages. Choose a class, court or day to print fewer.
no_more_matches_on_court: No more matches on this court
no_rules_title: The organiser hasn't published any rules yet
public_delay: Matches are running about {{minutes}} minutes late
public_delay_on_court: {{court}}: matches are running about {{minutes}} minutes late
public_pages_not_public: The public pages are off. Turn on the public dashboard above and choose an address to share them.
rules_description: Shown on the public rules page and can be printed. You can use Markdown: headings, bold, lists, links and tables. See the result under "Preview".
rules_placeholder: E.g. Matches are 2 x 10 minutes. No tables for 12 and younger (NFF).
team_no_matches_alert: This team has no scheduled matches yet.
team_not_found_alert: Could not find this team. It may not be drawn into a group yet.
team_page_qr_description: Share this page: scan the code with a phone camera.
team_search_placeholder: Search for a team or class
registration_description: Fill in the form to sign up your team. The contact details are only seen by the organiser.
registration_consent_label: The organiser may store and use these contact details for this cup.
registration_phone_validation: Enter a phone number (digits, optionally starting with +)
registration_closed_description: No class is open for registration right now.
registration_done_description: {{team}} is registered. The organiser will contact you.
registration_waitlist_description: The class is full, so {{team}} is on the waitlist, place {{place}}. You'll hear from the organiser if a spot opens up.
registrations_no_classes: Create classes first, then open them for registration here.
registration_not_public_alert: The public pages of this tournament are off, so teams can't sign up yet. Turn on the public dashboard in the settings.
registration_free_spot_hint: Free spots: {{count}}. Move the first team on the waitlist up?
entry_fee_calculator_description: (Fixed costs + cost per team × teams) × (1 + margin) ÷ teams, rounded up to the nearest 50 kr.
official_club_description: Warns when they referee a team of their own club
official_club_unknown: No club in the cup has this name. The own-club warning only works when it matches the club of the teams.
official_contact_private_note: Phone and email are only visible to organisers.
official_conflict_double_booked: {{name}} is booked twice at the same time: {{match}} and {{other}}
official_conflict_own_club: {{name}} referees a team of their own club: {{match}}
official_conflict_inactive: {{name}} is not available but still has matches
delete_official_confirm: Delete {{name}}? They are also removed from their matches.
no_officials_description: Add the referees and match hosts of the cup, then give them matches.
official_block_description: Quickest: give a referee all matches on a court in a period. Then adjust single matches below.
official_no_matches_description: Plan the matches first (Planning), then assign referees.
court_hosts_description: A match host (kampvert) welcomes teams and referees at a court and is the contact person there.
official_fees_description: Fee per match × matches + fee per day × days with a match or host period.
discipline_description: Cards are kept for classes from 13 years with public results (NFF). A red card suspends the player for the team's next match; the jury can change that.
delete_card_confirm: Delete this card? Its suspension disappears too.
suspension_per_red_description: Also for a second yellow in a match
yellow_cards_for_suspension_description: One match after every N-th yellow card
suspension_no_matches_left: The team has no more matches
discipline_no_cards: No cards yet. Cards are entered in the match form or on the pitch page.
jury_decision_placeholder: What did the jury decide, and why?
delete_jury_decision_confirm: Delete this decision from the log?
application_description: Everything the district (krets) asks for when you apply for the cup in FIKS, as text you can copy and paste. Dates, courts, classes and teams come from the cup; fill in the rest here.
application_missing_days: Playing days (set the playing hours on the planning page)
application_rules_summary_description: Short summary for the district. Empty: the rules from the public rules page are used.
application_text_heading: Application for approval of a tournament
application_text_results_hidden: no results or tables (NFF children's football)
notifications_description: Emails go to the contact person of each team (from the registration): sign-up confirmations, moving up from the waitlist, announcements and schedule changes. Each email only mentions that team.
notifications_not_set_up_title: Email is not set up on this server
notifications_not_set_up_description: You can write the email yourself: {{count}} team contacts, all in BCC so they don't see each other's addresses.
schedule_notice_description: Emails each team its next matches. Only teams whose times changed since their last email get one.
schedule_notice_preview: {{count}} of {{total}} teams with a contact have new times.
schedule_notice_confirm: {{count}} teams get an email with their next matches.
schedule_notice_sent: Emails to {{count}} teams are on their way
announcement_also_email_label: Also email it to the teams ({{count}} contacts)
setup_start_button: Set up the cup with the wizard
setup_hidden_results_note: Classes without shown results (NFF: age 12 and younger) play groups only: playoffs are placed by results.
entry_fee_needs_teams: Enter the expected number of teams
draw_empty_places_alert: {{count}} places will stay empty: their matches have no opponent. To avoid that, change the groups on the stages page before the draw (fewer or smaller groups).
check_in_question: Tap a team when it has arrived
participating_clubs_description: The clubs that take part with one or more teams. Teams of the same club are kept apart in the group draw.
participating_clubs_empty_description: Add the clubs that take part. You can create their teams at once, or link teams that are already registered.
participating_clubs_teams_without_club_o: {{count}} team has no club yet. Click a club to add it, or choose the club in the team's settings.
{{count}} teams have no club yet. Click a club to add them, or choose the club in a team's settings.
club_wizard_name_taken: This club already takes part in the cup
club_wizard_no_teams_without_club: All teams already have a club.
club_wizard_no_teams_note: The club has no teams yet. You can add them later.
club_edit_teams_description: The club's teams, and the teams that don't have a club yet
club_delete_confirm_description: The teams are kept, they just no longer belong to a club.
score_link_refused_now: This link doesn't work any more. What you see may be out of date; results can't be saved.
court_hours_description: When this pitch can be used. No days chosen: the cup's playing hours.
court_split_description: A split pitch (e.g. an 11v11 pitch as two 7v7 pitches): a match on the full pitch blocks its parts, a match on a part blocks the full pitch. The parts can be used at the same time.
group_size_too_large_error: More than the teams in the class
hours_days_description: No days chosen: whenever the cup plays.
hours_need_cup_hours: Set the cup's playing hours first.
match_started_description: A started match keeps its pitch and time when the schedule is changed.
max_matches_per_day_description: Per team. Empty: the default for the age.
plan_issue_outside_class_hours: {{match}} is outside the days/hours of its class
plan_issue_split_pitch_overlap: {{match}} uses the same ground as {{other}} (split pitch)
plan_issue_too_many_matches_per_day: {{match}}: a team plays more matches that day than its class allows
schedule_change_delay_description: The matches that haven't started keep their pitch and order and start at the earliest now + the delay. Later matches only move when they must; breaks such as lunch absorb the delay.
schedule_change_replan_description: Plans all matches that haven't been played or started again, not before the chosen time. Played and started matches stay where they are.
schedule_empty_wizard_hint: Set up classes, groups, playoffs, pitches and playing hours at once with the wizard.
score_link_extend_description: The link stays the same, so printed QR codes keep working.
setup_courts_suggested: Suggested from the classes (one group per format). Change it as you like; the overview shows whether everything fits.
active_next_stage_modal_description_no_u: This starts the next stage. No teams are moved automatically: place them in the stage yourself if needed.
server_error_registration_cup_closed: Registration for this cup is closed.
server_error_registration_class_closed: Registration for this class is closed.
server_error_registration_full: Too many teams are registered. Please contact the organiser.
server_error_registration_duplicate_team: A team with this name is already registered in this class. Choose another name, e.g. with a number.
server_error_score_link_invalid: This link is not valid (any more). Ask the organiser for a new one.
server_error_tournament_archived: The cup is archived and can't be changed.
server_error_score_link_wrong_match: This match can't be entered with this link.
server_error_match_teams_unknown: The teams of this match are not known yet.
server_error_score_link_wrong_team: This team can't be checked in with this link.
server_error_score_link_wrong_card: This card can't be changed with this link.
server_error_draw_wrong_stage: Teams can only be drawn into groups.
server_error_draw_wrong_class: All teams must belong to the class of the stage.
server_error_draw_not_participating: Teams on the waitlist or rejected teams can't be drawn.
server_error_draw_already_placed: Some of the teams are already in a group of this stage.
server_error_draw_too_many_teams: There are more teams than free places in the groups.
server_error_club_duplicate_name: A club with this name already takes part in this cup.
server_error_club_team_taken: Some of the teams already belong to another club.
server_error_registration_team_in_group: The team is placed in a group; remove it there before it leaves the cup.
server_error_registration_waitlist_empty: There are no teams on the waitlist.
server_error_too_many_requests: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
club_wizard_no_classes: The cup has no classes yet: create the classes first (cup setup or Classes).
club_wizard_no_teams_in_cup: There are no teams in the cup yet: create the club's teams above.
club_no_overlap_label: The club's teams never play at the same time
club_no_overlap_description: E.g. when the teams share coaches or players. The schedule keeps them apart.
category_kind_note_placeholder: E.g. girls may play a year down
registration_club_description: Several teams from one club? Sign them all up in this form.
registration_waitlist_note: Teams on the waitlist get a place when one becomes free; the organiser will contact you.
jury_members_description: NFF: the jury has at least three members, at most one from each club, with a chair (juryleder).
jury_warning_too_few_members: The jury needs at least three members.
jury_warning_same_club: Two jury members come from the same club.
team_conflicts_label: Can't play at the same time as
team_conflicts_description: Teams with the same coach or shared players: the schedule keeps their matches apart, with rest in between.
tiebreaker_lots_description: Enter the drawn lots per group with “Loddtrekning” on the stages page; until then a fixed random order is used.
lots_description: When teams are equal on everything else (and the ranking uses drawing of lots), the drawn order decides: 1 is best. Leave empty to use a fixed random order.
level_round_title: New round with groups by level
level_round_description: Put teams of a similar level in the same group. Nothing is decided by results, so this also works for children's classes. The round comes after the class's current stages.
ceremony_description: Final placings per class and when to hold its prize ceremony (after its last match). Children's classes have no placings: every player gets a medal. Medals are counted from the teams' number of players.
ceremony_no_schedule: No time yet: the matches are not planned.
ceremony_everyone_gets_medal: Children's football: no placings, every player gets a medal.
ceremony_no_classes: The cup has no classes yet.
application_missing_jury: The jury (add it on the discipline page: at least three members)
score_hidden_results_description: Children's football: no score is kept. Mark the match as played when it's over.
score_walkover_confirm_button: Tap again to confirm: {{team}} wins by W.O.
match_hidden_results_description: Children's football: results are not kept. Mark the match as played, or give a W.O. below.
official_block_title: Referee for a block of matches on a court
court_host_block_title: Match host for a court and period
dashboard_link_auto_description: Empty: made from the name. Parents use this address and the QR codes.
registration_no_address_alert: The cup has no address for its public page yet, so teams can't sign up. Set the address in the settings.
official_conflict_too_young: {{name}} is younger than 13 (NFF: club referees from 13 years)
court_undo_split_matches_one: {{count}} match is planned on the parts. It is taken off its pitch and time, so plan it again afterwards.
court_undo_split_matches_other: {{count}} matches are planned on the parts. They are taken off their pitch and time, so plan them again afterwards.
court_undo_split_blocked_one: {{count}} match on the parts is played or started, so the split can't be removed.
court_undo_split_blocked_other: {{count}} matches on the parts are played or started, so the split can't be removed.
court_undo_split_unschedule_button: Take the matches off and remove the split
player_import_description: A CSV file with one player per line: a column with the name ("Navn", or "Fornavn" and "Etternavn") and optionally the team ("Lag"). Players that already exist are skipped, but are still put on the team.
player_import_drop_title: Drop a CSV file here or click to choose one
player_import_drop_description: .csv or .txt, separated by semicolons, commas or tabs
player_import_excel_hint: From Excel: File › Save as › CSV (UTF-8)
player_import_default_team_description: For players without a team in the file
player_import_reason_team_not_found: Team "{{team}}" not found: imported without team
player_import_too_many: At most {{count}} players at a time. Split the file.
player_import_empty_file: No players found in the file.
player_import_done_skipped: {{count}} skipped (already existed or twice in the file).
player_import_done_not_added: {{count}} not put on the team, because they're on another team and the cup doesn't allow that: {{names}}.
help_tournaments_intro: The overview of your cups. Create a new cup here or open one you already have.
help_tournaments_step_1: Click “Create cup” and fill in the name, organising club and start time.
help_tournaments_step_2: Open the cup and use “Cup setup” to create classes, groups, pitches and playing hours in one go.
help_tournaments_step_3: Use the filter to show open or archived cups.
help_tournaments_field_filter_text: Choose whether to see open or archived cups.
help_tournaments_action_create_text: Creates a new, empty cup. You set it up afterwards with the wizard.
help_tournaments_action_open_text: Goes to the cup's planning and match-day pages.
help_tournaments_tip_1: A cup belongs to an organising club. Create the club under “Organising clubs” first if the list is empty.
help_organiser_clubs_intro: The clubs that organise cups, e.g. your own sports club. These are not the clubs that take part with teams: add those under “Participating clubs” in each cup.
help_organiser_clubs_step_2: Pick it when you create a cup.
help_organiser_clubs_field_name_text: The name of the organising club.
help_organiser_clubs_action_delete_text: Deletes the club. Only possible when it has no cups.
help_capacity_intro: Works out whether a planned cup fits on the pitches and in the playing hours, before any team has signed up. Matches are planned the same way as in the real cup.
help_capacity_step_1: Pick the days and playing hours (with a lunch break).
help_capacity_step_2: Add the classes: age, number of teams, group size and playoffs. The age fills in the NFF defaults.
help_capacity_step_3: Add the pitches with their format, split if needed.
help_capacity_step_4: Click “Calculate” and see whether everything fits.
help_capacity_field_classes_text: Number of teams, group size, playoffs (A, A+B, A+B+C), match length, break, rest, format and max matches per day.
help_capacity_field_courts_text: Number of pitches per format. A pitch can be split, e.g. one 11v11 into two 7v7.
help_capacity_field_buffer_text: Minutes between the last group match and the first playoff match of a class.
help_capacity_action_calculate_text: Plans all matches and shows whether they fit, how many pitches or how much time is missing, and NFF warnings.
help_capacity_tip_1: NFF: children up to 13 should get at least three matches.
help_capacity_tip_2: If it doesn't fit, try fewer teams per group, shorter matches or one more pitch.
help_user_intro: Your user account: name, email, password and the app language.
help_user_field_password_text: Change your password here. Use a long one.
help_setup_intro: The wizard creates the whole cup in one go: playing hours, classes with groups and playoffs, and pitches. Teams are drawn into the groups afterwards.
help_setup_step_1: Playing hours: pick the days, start and end and the lunch break.
help_setup_step_2: Classes: add a row per class. The age fills in format, match length, rest and whether results are shown (NFF). Pick days and hours per class if needed.
help_setup_step_3: Pitches: the suggestion comes from the classes' formats. Split a pitch if it is used as several smaller ones.
help_setup_step_4: Overview: see whether everything fits and how many matches there are per day, then click “Create cup”.
help_setup_field_age_text: Used for the NFF rules: up to 12, results and tables are not shown and there are no playoffs.
help_setup_field_teams_text: How many teams you expect, and how many per group.
help_setup_field_playoffs_text: None, A, A+B or A+B+C. Group placings are split across the playoffs.
help_setup_field_rest_text: Minutes a team rests at least between two matches.
help_setup_field_per_day_text: Per team. The planner stays within it.
help_setup_action_create_text: Creates classes, group stages, playoffs, pitches and playing hours, and plans the matches right away if chosen.
help_setup_tip_1: The wizard only works in a cup without classes and stages.
help_setup_tip_2: Nothing is saved until you click “Create cup”, and you can go back between the steps.
help_categories_intro: The age classes of the cup, e.g. G10 and J13. Each class has its own format, match length and rules for results.
help_categories_step_1: Add a class with a name and age.
help_categories_step_2: Check match length, break, rest and format.
help_categories_step_3: Watch the “NFF rules” column for warnings, e.g. too few matches.
help_categories_field_age_text: Controls the NFF rules for results and tables.
help_categories_field_kind_text: Boys, girls or mixed, and a note (e.g. girls may play a year down).
help_categories_field_results_text: Off for children's football: the public only sees “Played”.
help_categories_field_format_text: Matches are only planned on pitches with this format.
help_categories_field_days_text: When the class can play. Empty: all of the cup's playing hours.
help_categories_action_edit_text: Changes the class. Matches without their own timing follow the change.
help_categories_action_delete_text: Deletes the class. Not possible when it has teams or stages.
help_categories_tip_1: NFF § 6-5: up to 12, results and tables are not published.
help_teams_intro: All teams in the cup. Click a team to edit it.
help_teams_step_1: Add teams one by one or several at once.
help_teams_step_2: Pick the class and club for each team.
help_teams_step_3: Tick “Checked in” when the team has arrived on match day.
help_teams_field_class_text: The class the team plays in.
help_teams_field_club_text: The team's club. The draw keeps teams of the same club in different groups.
help_teams_action_add_text: One team, or many by writing one team per line.
help_teams_action_edit_text: Name, class, club, squad size, players and teams that can't play at the same time.
help_teams_action_withdraw_text: The team withdraws: opponents get a W.O. win in the remaining matches. The schedule stays.
help_teams_action_delete_text: Deletes the team. Not possible when it is placed in a group.
help_teams_tip_1: Waitlisted or rejected teams are not shown here, but under “Registrations”.
help_team_edit_field_name_text: The team name, up to 50 characters.
help_team_edit_field_club_text: Pick the club, or type a new name and choose “+ New club”.
help_team_edit_field_squad_text: Optional. Used to count medals for the prize ceremony.
help_team_edit_field_no_overlap: Can't play at the same time as
help_team_edit_field_no_overlap_text: Teams with a shared coach or players. The planner never schedules them at the same time.
help_players_intro: The players of the cup. You only need players if you want to record cards by name or keep team lists.
help_players_step_1: Add players one by one, many as text, or import from a file.
help_players_step_2: When importing: download the template, fill it in Excel and save as CSV.
help_players_field_file_text: CSV or text. Columns: Name (or First and Last name), Team, Active. Semicolon, comma or tab.
help_players_field_team_text: The team for players without a team in the file.
help_players_action_import_text: Shows each line as new, already exists or invalid before anything is saved. Up to 2000 players.
help_players_action_template_text: A CSV file with the right columns.
help_players_tip_1: Players that already exist are not created again, but are put on the team.
help_clubs_intro: The clubs taking part with teams, and their teams. The club is used to keep teams of the same club in different groups, and for referee warnings.
help_clubs_step_1: Click “Add club” and type the name.
help_clubs_step_2: Create new teams per class, or link teams without a club. Teams starting with the club name are pre-selected.
help_clubs_field_name_text: Must be unique in the cup.
help_clubs_field_no_overlap: The club's teams must not play at the same time
help_clubs_field_no_overlap_text: For clubs with shared coaches. The planner respects it.
help_clubs_action_add_text: Opens the wizard for a new club.
help_clubs_action_edit_text: Rename, add or remove teams, or create new teams.
help_clubs_action_delete_text: The teams are kept, they just no longer belong to the club.
help_clubs_tip_1: Sign-up on the cup page finds or creates the club automatically.
help_club_wizard_intro: Create a club with its teams in three steps.
help_club_wizard_step_2: Pick a class and number of teams: names are suggested (e.g. “Brann B10 2”) and can be changed. Optionally link teams without a club.
help_club_wizard_step_3: Check the overview and click create.
help_club_wizard_field_name_text: A name that already exists is refused.
help_club_wizard_action_create_text: Creates the club and the teams in one go.
help_registrations_intro: Registered teams with contact person, status and payment. This is where you open the classes for sign-up on the cup page.
help_registrations_step_1: Turn on “Open for registration” per class, set the deadline, max teams and fee, and save.
help_registrations_step_2: Share the link to the sign-up form.
help_registrations_step_3: Follow the teams: approve, reject, move up from the waitlist, and tick paid and squad reported.
help_registrations_field_open_text: Shows the class in the sign-up form.
help_registrations_field_max_text: When the class is full, new teams go on the waitlist.
help_registrations_field_fee_text: Kroner per team. Shown in the form and in the paid totals.
help_registrations_field_status_text: Approved, registered, waitlist or rejected. Only approved and registered teams take part.
help_registrations_action_move_up_text: Gives the first waitlisted team a free place.
help_registrations_action_calculator_tex: Suggests a fee from costs, number of teams and margin, and can apply it to chosen classes.
help_registrations_tip_1: Contact details are only shown to the organiser.
help_registrations_tip_2: Expect 10–20% of the teams to drop out.
help_draw_intro: Draws the teams of a class into the free places of its groups, and reveals the draw team by team, e.g. on a big screen.
help_draw_step_2: Choose the number of pots and each team’s pot (pot 1 is the strongest). Pots are saved on the teams.
help_draw_step_3: Click “Draw”. Teams appear one by one; “Show all” shows the rest.
help_draw_field_pots_text: Each group gets one team from every pot. 1 means fully random. The badges show how many teams each pot has; a pot should not have more teams than there are groups.
help_draw_action_draw_text: Places the teams. Teams of the same club end up in different groups as far as possible.
help_draw_action_fullscreen_text: Shows the groups large, for a big screen.
help_draw_tip_1: If places stay empty, those matches have no opponent. Change the groups before the draw.
help_draw_tip_2: To move a team afterwards, do it in the group under “Stages”.
help_stages_intro: Group stages and playoffs per class, and which teams are in which group. This is where you start the next part when the group stage is done.
help_stages_step_1: Pick the class at the top.
help_stages_step_2: Check the groups and teams. Pick a team in a place to change it.
help_stages_step_3: When the group stage is over: click “Next part”. Teams are placed in the playoffs by their placing.
help_stages_action_add_stage_text: Creates a new part, e.g. a level-split round.
help_stages_action_add_item_text: A new group (round robin) or knockout in a part.
help_stages_action_playoffs_text: A, B and C playoffs from the group placings.
help_stages_action_next_text: Switches the active part. Going back discards the playoff results.
help_stages_action_lots_text: Enter the order when teams are completely tied.
help_stages_tip_1: Children's football (up to 12) only has group stages, but you can compose a level-split round by hand.
help_stage_item_intro: Adds a group or knockout to a part of the stages.
help_stage_item_field_type_text: Round robin: every team meets all others once. Knockout: the loser is out.
help_stage_item_field_teams_text: 2–64. If it isn't 2, 4, 8, 16 …, the best teams get a bye in the first round.
help_stage_item_field_bronze_text: The semi-final losers play for third place.
help_stage_item_action_create_text: Creates the group and its matches.
help_playoffs_intro: Creates A, B and C playoffs from the group placings. Teams from the same group meet as late as possible.
help_playoffs_field_placings_text: Which places go to this playoff, e.g. 1 and 2 to A.
help_playoffs_field_best_text: Also takes the best teams at one place across the groups, e.g. the two best third-placed teams.
help_playoffs_action_create_text: Creates the playoffs as a new part.
help_playoffs_tip_1: Not possible in classes with hidden results (children's football).
help_schedule_intro: When and where every match is played. This is where you create the schedule automatically, change pitches and playing hours, handle delays and create result links for the pitches.
help_schedule_step_2: Click “Create schedule”, check the proposal and apply it.
help_schedule_step_3: Create result links (QR) for the pitches and print match sheets.
help_schedule_step_4: On match day: use “Delay and re-plan” and send new times to the teams.
help_schedule_field_hours_text: Days, start, end and lunch break.
help_schedule_field_courts_text: Format, opening hours and splitting. A match on a full pitch blocks its parts, and the other way round.
help_schedule_field_delay_text: Delay the matches on a pitch or class, or re-plan everything from a time. You see the changes before saving.
help_schedule_field_links_text: One link per pitch that lets someone at the pitch enter results without an account.
help_schedule_field_announcement_text: A message at the top of all public pages, e.g. during a thunderstorm.
help_schedule_action_plan_text: Plans all matches. Played and started matches don't move. Tells how many pitches or how much time is missing.
help_schedule_action_drag_text: Moves the match to another pitch or slot.
help_schedule_action_notify_text: Emails new times to teams whose times changed.
help_schedule_action_cards_text: Printout with space for the result, referee and notes.
help_schedule_tip_1: Re-planning never puts matches in the past.
help_schedule_tip_2: Messages from the pitches (delays) are shown at the top until marked done.
help_officials_intro: The people who referee matches and welcome teams at the pitches, who has which matches, and the fees.
help_officials_step_1: People: add referees and match hosts.
help_officials_step_2: Schedule: pick a referee per match, or give one referee all matches on a pitch for a period.
help_officials_step_3: Match hosts: put a host on a pitch for a period.
help_officials_step_4: Fees: see the total per person and export.
help_officials_field_age_text: Warns about referees under 13 or younger than the players.
help_officials_field_club_text: Warns when they referee a team from their own club.
help_officials_field_fees_text: Kroner. The total is shown under “Fees”.
help_officials_field_available_text: Off: warns if the person is still assigned.
help_officials_action_block_text: Gives the referee all matches on a pitch between two times.
help_officials_tip_1: The warnings at the top show double bookings, own club and age.
help_officials_tip_2: Phone and email are only shown to the organiser.
help_results_intro: Enter and correct results for all matches, sorted by time and pitch.
help_results_step_2: Enter the goals, or mark the match as played in children's football.
help_results_step_3: Save the result. Tables and playoffs update.
help_results_action_edit_text: Opens the match: result, type (normal, extra time, penalties, W.O.), cards and length.
help_results_tip_1: At the pitch it's easiest to use the result links (QR) from the schedule.
help_match_edit_intro: Result and details of one match.
help_match_edit_field_score_text: Normal, extra time, penalties or W.O.
help_match_edit_field_started_text: A started match keeps its pitch and time when re-planning.
help_match_edit_field_cards_text: Yellow, second yellow and red (from 13). Gives suspensions automatically.
help_match_edit_action_save_text: The match counts as played and in the table.
help_match_edit_action_live_text: Shown on the cup page, but the match doesn't count as finished.
help_match_edit_action_wo_text: The other team didn't show: the winner gets the W.O. score from the settings.
help_discipline_intro: Cards, suspensions and the jury's decisions. For classes from 13 with public results.
help_discipline_step_1: Set the rules: matches suspended per red card, and optionally after N yellow cards.
help_discipline_step_2: Cards are entered in the match (results or result link). Suspensions are calculated automatically.
help_discipline_step_3: Add the jury and record decisions in the jury log.
help_discipline_field_red_text: Also applies to a second yellow in one match.
help_discipline_field_jury_text: At least three members, at most one per club, and a chair (NFF).
help_discipline_field_decision_text: What the jury decided and why. Can change the suspension for a card.
help_discipline_action_log_text: Saves the decision with who decided.
help_discipline_tip_1: Suspended players are shown on the result link and the match sheet.
help_rankings_intro: How many points a win, draw and loss give, and how teams on equal points are separated.
help_rankings_field_points: Points for win, draw and loss
help_rankings_field_tiebreakers_text: The order: e.g. goal difference, goals scored, head-to-head, fair play and drawing lots.
help_rankings_field_fair_play: Points per yellow and red card
help_rankings_field_fair_play_text: Used by fair play: fewest points wins.
help_rankings_tip_1: The drawing of lots is entered per group under “Stages”.
help_ceremony_intro: Final placings per class, when the ceremony can be held, and how many medals are needed.
help_ceremony_field_minutes_text: Suggested ceremony time after the class's last match.
help_ceremony_action_print_text: A printout for the prize table.
help_ceremony_tip_1: Children's football: no placings, everyone gets a medal. Medal counts come from the squad size per team.
help_settings_intro: The cup's name, organising club, timing and the public cup page.
help_settings_field_start_text: Also set when you save the playing hours.
help_settings_field_timing_text: Defaults for classes without their own.
help_settings_field_buffer_text: Minutes between the last group match and the first playoff match.
help_settings_field_wo_text: Goals the team that doesn't show loses by.
help_settings_field_public_text: Off: only logged-in users see the cup.
help_settings_action_archive_text: Locks the cup when it's over. Can be reopened.
help_settings_action_delete_text: Deletes everything in the cup. Can't be undone.
help_application_intro: Everything the district asks for when you apply for the cup in FIKS, as text you can copy. Dates, pitches and classes come from the cup; you fill in the rest.
help_application_step_1: Fill in organising club, venue, contact person and jury.
help_application_step_2: Watch “Still missing” until the list is empty.
help_application_step_3: Click “Copy text” and paste it into FIKS.
help_application_field_rules_text: Short summary. Empty: the rules from the public rules page.
help_match_cards_intro: Printout of match sheets: two per row, with teams, time, pitch, referee, boxes for the result and space for notes and signatures.
help_match_cards_action_print_text: Opens printing. A sheet is never split across two pages.
help_match_cards_tip_1: Suspended players are listed on the sheet.
help_pitch_intro: Here you enter the results for the matches on this pitch. No login needed.
help_pitch_step_1: Tap a team when it has arrived.
help_pitch_step_2: Tap “Start the match” when you begin.
help_pitch_step_3: Use + and − for the goals and tap “Save result”. In children's football just tap “Match played”.
help_pitch_step_4: The next match comes up by itself.
help_pitch_action_wo_text: When a team doesn't show. Tap twice to confirm.
help_pitch_action_delay_text: Tell the organiser the pitch is running late.
help_pitch_tip_1: If you lose the connection, what you typed stays until it's back.
help_public_matches_intro: The cup's match programme: time, pitch and teams. Pick a class to see only that one.
help_public_matches_tip_1: In children's football (up to 12) results aren't shown, only “Played”.
help_public_teams_intro: All teams, ordered by class. Search for your team and tap it.
help_public_teams_field_search_text: Finds the team even without special letters (“asane” finds Åsane).
help_public_team_intro: One team's matches, with the next match highlighted.
help_public_team_action_calendar_text: Subscribe to the team's matches in your phone calendar. Changes arrive automatically.
help_public_team_action_poster_text: A poster with a QR code to this page.
help_public_team_tip_1: Tables are only shown for classes from 13.
help_public_courts_intro: What is playing now and the next match on each pitch. Tap a pitch for its full programme.
help_public_standings_intro: Group tables and playoffs for the classes with public results (from 13).
help_public_standings_tip_1: On equal points the cup's table rules are used, e.g. goal difference and head-to-head.
help_public_rules_intro: The cup's rules, written by the organiser.
help_public_register_intro: Sign up one or more teams from your club. The organiser sees the contact details; they are not public.
help_public_register_step_1: Pick the class and type the team name. Add more teams if your club enters several.
help_public_register_step_2: Fill in club and contact person.
help_public_register_step_3: Accept that the organiser stores the details, and tap “Sign up”.
help_public_register_tip_1: If the class is full, the team goes on the waitlist with a place number.
markdown_syntax_help: Formatting: ## Heading · **bold** · *italic* · - list · 1. numbered list · [text](https://…) · a blank line starts a new paragraph. Tables: | Class | Time | and a line | --- | --- |.
help_settings_field_rules_text: The cup's rules for the public rules page. Write in Markdown (headings, bold, lists, links, tables) and check the result under "Preview".
draw_pots_saved_note: Pots are saved on the teams straight away. You can also set a team’s pot under “Teams”.
draw_pot_too_big_alert: Pot {{pot}} has {{count}} teams but there are only {{groups}} groups, so some groups get more than one team from this pot. Move teams to another pot if every group should get one.
help_draw_tip_3: Set the pots in advance under “Teams” (edit a team), e.g. while approving sign-ups.
help_team_edit_field_pot_text: Optional. Teams of the same pot end up in different groups. 1 is the strongest; empty means pot 1.
